tagline: Make agent data traceable, typed and time-aware.
introduction: A companion for planning structured data questions with Cala, focusing on provenance, data types and what a fact actually establishes.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Cala? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Frame a structured data question
capabilities.description: Translate a research goal into fields, scope and freshness requirements.

capabilities.title: Review provenance
capabilities.description: Review exact field-value, source-digest and source/observation-time bindings in supplied data without treating a citation as truth.
inputs: fictional or redacted sample record with supplied artifacts and timestamps
outputs: field-level consistency, provenance gaps and freshness report; not source authentication

capabilities.title: Plan a verifiable query
capabilities.description: Describe a query and validation path without executing a service call.

starterPrompts: I want an agent to compare company facts. Help me define typed fields, source provenance and freshness requirements for Cala.
Review this sample company record and flag missing source, validity and historical-change information.
Using this supplied Cala schema, outline a query plan and tests for stale or contradictory facts.

sources.summary: Official description of structured data for agents, with types, provenance and history.
